verdict.rationale: Modal documents programmatic creation of sandboxes at massive concurrency: hundreds of thousands of concurrent rollout environments in seconds, thousands of concurrent GPU runs, and a higher-throughput backend for creation rates. That supports fanning work out across many items. However, the evidence shows no dedicated bulk or batch operation (e.g., acting on many sandboxes in a single call or filtering many items at once). Bulk work appears to come from scripting the per-sandbox SDK. Missing for 10: an explicit batch/bulk API or CLI command for acting on many sandboxes at once, documentation of bulk management (terminate, list, filter many), and hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
